summary.text: Fentrice Driskell represents District 67 in the Florida House of Representatives as a Democrat, elected in 2018 and reelected subsequently.

paragraphs.text: Driskell was House Minority Leader from 2022 to 2024 and House Democratic Policy Chair from 2020 to 2022.
Driskell is an attorney who lives in Tampa and was born in Winter Haven, Florida. Driskell holds a B.A. from Harvard University (2001) and a J.D. from Georgetown University Law Center (2004).
